entities.summary: Jordan Christopher Caroline is an American professional basketball player for Rytas Vilnius of the Lithuanian Basketball League (LKL) and the Basketball Champions League (BCL). He played college basketball for the Southern Illinois Salukis and the Nevada Wolf Pack.
